questions.question: David sang a song to the LORD after being rescued from all his enemies and from the hand of whom?
In David's song of thanks, what did he do when the cords and snares of death surrounded him?

answers.text: He cried out to the LORD

questions.question: In his song, David says the waves of death engulfed him. What did the LORD do for him?

answers.text: He reached down and drew him out
He calmed the waves around him
He sent an angel to lift him up

questions.question: At the end of David's song to the LORD, who does he say God shows loving devotion to?

answers.text: The soldiers who fought beside him
